stem_book: A point moves in a straight line so that its displacement x m at time t sec is given by x² = 1 + t². Its acceleration in m/sec² at a time t sec is: (a) 1/x³ (b) −t/x³ (c) 1/x − t²/x³ (d) 1/x − 1/x²
reason: Options (a) and (c) are the same quantity: 1/x − t²/x³ = (x² − t²)/x³ = 1/x³ since x² − t² = 1, so two options are correct for a single-answer question (key gives only c). Usable only as multi-correct a,c or with (a) replaced.
work: x·v = t ⇒ v = t/x ⇒ a = (x − t·v)/x² = 1/x − t²/x³ = (x² − t²)/x³ = 1/x³
